steps.name: rapid scroll leaves a healthy frame
hidden tab pauses and resumes
steps.js: (async () => { const s = window.__stage; Object.defineProperty(document, 'hidden', { configurable: true, get: () => true }); document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); const t0 = s.s.t; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const paused = s.s.t === t0; Object.defineProperty(document, 'hidden', { configurable: true, get: () => false }); document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const dt = s.s.t - t0; return paused && dt > 0.1 && dt < 0.9; })()
